components.name: Time
components.description: A moment, shown absolute (format) or relative ('3 hours ago', 'in 5 min'). Relative time ticks inside the component: a blok never reads the wall clock. While time-travelling it is measured from then, the viewed moment, so the past renders as it did (new in ui@1).

props.description: Extra Tailwind classes appended to the element.
How an absolute moment is written, as fmt.datetime's format; the viewer's locale default when left out. Ignored when relative.
Show the distance to now (live) or to then (travelling) instead of the moment, ticking as it changes.
The moment, an ISO 8601 datetime. Null renders nothing.
